title: SMC Industries, Inc.
content:
SMC Industries, Inc. supplies custom thermal insulation products for industrial projects and publicly markets precision-cut aerogel blanket solutions for piping, fittings, and vessel applications. The company positions its hydrophobic blanket offering for corrosion-under-insulation mitigation, thermal-efficiency retention, and easier field installation across process-industry environments.

On its official website, SMC says it supports end users, contractors, engineering firms, and distributors and highlights project work in oil & gas, petrochemical, LNG, and related industrial insulation markets. This makes the company relevant for buyers seeking fabricated aerogel-blanket supply and project-ready insulation support rather than raw aerogel manufacturing.

  • Coverage Area: United States and international industrial project markets
  • Focus Areas: Precision-cut aerogel blanket supply, custom insulation fabrication, industrial piping and vessel insulation, and corrosion-under-insulation risk reduction
  • Current Brands Represented: Project-specified hydrophobic blanket systems and custom-fabricated aerogel insulation solutions; buyers should confirm brand and blanket specification directly with SMC
  • Official Website: https://www.smcindustries.com/
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
